author: juan
body: Does the foundation have authority to take a fund LP position at all? The grants export shows none in seven years, which is evidence of practice, not of the trust deed.

author: ines
body: Is the 2027 budget set? Nothing public since the March 2026 page update.

author: tomas
body: Where did counsel land on §4944(c)? The only note we have is two years old.

author: mara
body: Programme lead was warm but careful on the phone. Reading between the lines, the foundation has been approached a lot this year.

author: mara
body: Is Priya Raman's emerging-manager programme open for 2026? She has held the seat three weeks; the only figures we have for Northwood come from a 2021 CSV nobody can vouch for.

author: juan
body: Michael Okonjo is both a possible connector to Roos and a prospect in his own right. Those two roles should not be resolved by whoever gets there first.

author: tomas
body: Sourced, not applied for. Any outreach on the grants rail stays blocked until an invitation exists — that is a state machine guard at L13, not a reminder.
